events.description: CC CPSU Politburo session hears Andropov's report on talks in Afghanistan; Ustinov says withdrawal not possible for a year to a year and a half; Brezhnev suggests increasing the contingent; resolution approved.
Andropov travelled to Afghanistan at Karmal's request and met Karmal, Sarvari, Gulabzoi, Vatandzhar, Nur, Zerai and Kadyr.
Removal of Amin from power, about a month before Andropov's visit.
Soviet-Afghan agreement on an oil refinery with capacity of 100 thousand tons per year.
CC CPSU Politburo session where Andropov reports on his Afghanistan trip; conversations approved and resolution accepted.
Andropov traveled to Afghanistan at Karmal's request and met Afghan leaders.
Andropov met Sarvari, Gulabzoi, Vatandzhar, Nur, Zerai and Kadyr on party unity and the army.
Removal of Amin from power, about a month before Andropov's visit.
Soviet-Afghan agreement on an oil refinery of 100 thousand tons per year; Afghans now request 500 thousand.

key_claims: Andropov told the Politburo that the situation in Afghanistan was stabilizing a month after Amin's removal.
Andropov pressed Afghan leaders to heal the Khalq-Parcham rift and unify the party.
Ustinov argued Soviet withdrawal could not be considered for a year to a year and a half.
Brezhnev proposed increasing the Soviet contingent in Afghanistan somewhat.
Gromyko argued withdrawal should be tied to agreed obligations guaranteeing Afghan security.
Afghan leaders requested Soviet economic aid including an expanded oil refinery, power, the Ainak copper project and an Amu Darya bridge.
